name: harvest
description: Read Harvest evidence for invoice readiness and unbilled-work review without changing provider records.

auth.label: Harvest connection
auth.hint: Attach a harvest credential with secret_apiKey containing a personal access token; configure accountId separately. The plugin enforces GET-only reads; the PAT itself retains full user permissions.

marketplace.tagline: Read Harvest source evidence for reviewed invoice drafts.
useCases: Compare project/time evidence with existing invoices
Build reviewed drafts in OrgSDK without writing to the provider
marketplace.permissionsSummary: Reads only one configured Harvest account using the attached token: current identity, projects, time entries and invoices. Token permissions depend on the user and are broader than this plugin. No writes, timer controls, email, payments or deletion.
